text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
CORN SALE - Taiwan's Members Feed Industry Group bought a 56,000-tonne shipment of U.S. No.2 corn from Mitsui at a tender on Wednesday for June shipment, traders said.

The CCC of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it had purchased a total of 9,690 tonnes of U.S. yellow corn from Cargill Inc for export to Angola and Kenya, May 5-31 delivery. The corn was priced at $128.10 per tonne, FOB Reserve. A total of 5,000 tonnes were purchased for Angola and 4,690 tonnes for Kenya, CCC said.
WHEAT SALE - The Taiwan Flour Mills Association bought 68,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat from Columbia Grain International in two shipments at a tender on Wednesday, traders said.

SORGHUM SALE - The CCC of USDA said it had purchased 5,000 tonnes of U.S. sorghum from Archer Daniels Midland Co for export to Kenya, May 5-31 delivery. The sorghum was priced at $124.33 per tonne, FOB Reserve.
WHEAT TENDER - Results were awaited on Iraq's tender from April 18 for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. HRW wheat for June arrival.
Results are awaited on Algeria's tender for 100,000 tonnes of optional durum wheat for shipment in May and June.
WHEAT TENDERS - Jordan was to tender May 1 for 120,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter and/or northern spring wheat for May/June shipment.
BARLEY TENDER - Turkey on April 29 seeks 150,000 tonnes of barley in three 50,000-tonne shipments. It seeks white feed and malting white barley for May 15-22 and June 1-15 shipment.
RICE TENDER - South Korea is to tender at the end of June to buy 77,000 tonnes of rice to meet its 1997 WTO quota.

OILSEED TENDER - Results were awaited on South Korea's tender for 53,500 tonnes of oilseed meal, including 14,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal, 6,500 tonnes cottonseed meal, 8,000 tonnes of grain screening pellet and 25,000 tonnes of palm kernel meal.
SOYMEAL TENDER - El Salvador is to tender April 28 for 8,000 to 10,000 tonnes of PL-480 soybean meal for May 7-22 shipment, the buyer's agent said.

COMMODITY TENDER - The Commodity Credit Corp of USDA said it will tender April 29 for pinto beans, sunflower oil, bulgur and wheat-soy blend for donation to Moldova. It seeks 255 tonnes of pinto beans, 605 tonnes of sunflower oil, 510 tonnes of bulgur (cracked wheat), and 255 tonnes of a wheat-soy blend. The beans, bulgur and wheat-soy blend were for June 6-20 shipment and the oil was for June 20-July 5.
MARKET TALK - Pakistan may seek anywhere from 200,000 to 300,000 tonnes optional origin wheat as early as this weekend with the United States, the most likely supplier, several U.S. exporters said.

... Brazilian traders said they had heard talk of Chinese interest for South American soymeal and soyoil over the last 10 days but the quantities actually sold may be smaller than rumored on the Chicago market. None of the traders would confirm any purchases, but one soymeal trader said he heard talk China last week bought two loads of 50,000 tonnes Brazilian soymeal each for June and July shipment.

... A U.S. delegation will hold discussions this week with Indian companies and officials on wheat specifications, but the talks will not cover sales to India, a U.S. embassy spokesman said. An American wheat team is visiting India on April 24-25.
... European Commission director general for agriculture Guy Legras said the European Union could export wheat without subsidy between 1997 and 2005 but not regularly.

... Thailand has gone on a buying spree, picking up 38,000 tonnes of corn from Argentina and 50,000 tonnes of Brazilian soybeans, traders said on Wednesday. Thailand may also be in the market for another 50,000 tonnes of soybeans and 20,000 tonnes of soymeal, they added.
... Iran will need to import five million tonnes of wheat in the year to March 21, 1998, a senior official said in remarks published on Wednesday.
